name: Controller Tweaks and Remap
summary: Configure controller bindings through Mod Settings, swap shoulders and triggers, enjoy a wider walking range, and use short press Map / long press Game Hub.
thumbnailAltText: Controller Tweaks and Remap title over an official in-game screenshot of Coen walking through a town market.
requiredMods: UE4SS for BoD by Framecore 2b+ OR UE4SS for Dawnwalker by Vercadi RC6+
fileDescription: Configure controls through Mod Settings, apply changes on save load, and use the linked-action and Focus input fixes in one main download. Improves controller recovery after loading.

historicalOptionalFiles.description: Preset 1.5.2: same eight bindings; refreshed docs. Requires main 1.4.0+ and UE4SS. MANUAL ONLY: back up ControllerTweaks.ini before applying. Replacement overwrites preferences; see README to preserve other settings. Do not install via Vortex.
